-- What a client importing `Proof.github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.StartRes` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem etcdstart.memberFreshRes_boot [go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.Assumptions] (n :
    GoString) (γn : NetNames GF) (cfg : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.config.ServerConfig) (hd :
    cfg.DataDir' = n ++ go!".etcd") (hw : cfg.DedicatedWALDir' = []) : etcdstart.memberFreshRes n {
    } γn ⊢ wal.bootRes cfg

theorem etcdstart.memberRestartRes_intro (n p : GoString) (γn : NetNames GF) (γ : SrvRaft) (ρ :
    ReqNames) (id : w64) : srvDiskImage γ ρ id (n ++ go!".etcd") ∗ netAddrFree p ∗ http.httpProtoOwn
    p (raftProto (netRh γn)) ⊢ etcdstart.memberRestartRes n { peer := some p } γn γ ρ id

def (sealed) etcdstart.memberRestartRes (name : GoString) (a : etcdstart.MemberAddrs) (γn : NetNames
    GF) (γ : SrvRaft) (ρ : ReqNames) (id : w64) : IProp GF

theorem etcdstart.memberFreshRes_client (n : GoString) (a : etcdstart.MemberAddrs) (γn : NetNames
    GF) (c : GoString) (h : a.client = some c) : etcdstart.memberFreshRes n a γn ⊢ netAddrFree c ∗
    etcdstart.memberFreshRes n { peer := a.peer } γn

theorem etcdstart.memberStartRes_of_lists_all.{u_1} (ms : List (GoString × etcdstart.MemberAddrs)) :
    (([∗list] x ∈ List.flatMap (fun m => m.snd.addrs) ms, netAddrFree x) ∗ ([∗list] x ∈ List.flatMap
    (fun m => m.snd.addrs) ms, httpProtoFree x) ∗ [∗list] d ∈ List.map (fun m =>
    etcdstart.memberWalDir m.fst) ms, walDirFresh d) ⊢ [∗list] m ∈ ms, etcdstart.memberStartRes
    m.fst m.snd

def (sealed) etcdstart.memberStartRes.{u_1} (name : GoString) (a : etcdstart.MemberAddrs) : IProp GF

theorem etcdstart.memberStartRes_of_lists.{u_1} (n : GoString) (a : etcdstart.MemberAddrs) :
    ([∗list] x ∈ a.addrs, netAddrFree x) ∗ ([∗list] x ∈ a.addrs, httpProtoFree x) ∗ walDirFresh
    (etcdstart.memberWalDir n) ⊢ etcdstart.memberStartRes n a

theorem etcdstart.memberRestartRes_boot (n : GoString) (γn : NetNames GF) (γ : SrvRaft) (ρ :
    ReqNames) (id : w64) : etcdstart.memberRestartRes n { } γn γ ρ id ⊢ srvDiskImage γ ρ id (n ++
    go!".etcd")

structure etcdstart.MemberAddrs : Type where
  peer : Option GoString
  client : Option GoString

theorem etcdstart.memberFreshRes_peer (n : GoString) (a : etcdstart.MemberAddrs) (γn : NetNames GF)
    (p : GoString) (h : a.peer = some p) : etcdstart.memberFreshRes n a γn ⊢ (netAddrFree p ∗
    http.httpProtoOwn p (raftProto (netRh γn))) ∗ etcdstart.memberFreshRes n { client := a.client }
    γn

theorem etcdstart.memberRestartRes_peer (n : GoString) (a : etcdstart.MemberAddrs) (γn : NetNames
    GF) (γ : SrvRaft) (ρ : ReqNames) (id : w64) (p : GoString) (h : a.peer = some p) :
    etcdstart.memberRestartRes n a γn γ ρ id ⊢ (netAddrFree p ∗ http.httpProtoOwn p (raftProto
    (netRh γn))) ∗ etcdstart.memberRestartRes n { client := a.client } γn γ ρ id

theorem etcdstart.memberStartRes_intro.{u_1} (ms : List (GoString × etcdstart.MemberAddrs)) (Bs As
    Ds : List GoString) (hA : (List.flatMap (fun m => m.snd.addrs) ms ++ Bs).Perm As) (hD :
    (List.map (fun m => etcdstart.memberWalDir m.fst) ms).Perm Ds) : (([∗list] a ∈ As, netAddrFree
    a) ∗ ([∗list] a ∈ As, httpProtoFree a) ∗ [∗list] d ∈ Ds, walDirFresh d) ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈ ms,
    etcdstart.memberStartRes m.fst m.snd) ∗ [∗list] b ∈ Bs, netAddrFree b

def etcdstart.MemberAddrs.addrs (a : etcdstart.MemberAddrs) : List GoString :=
  a.peer.toList ++ a.client.toList

theorem etcdstart.memberRestartRes_raft (n : GoString) (a : etcdstart.MemberAddrs) (γn : NetNames
    GF) (γ : SrvRaft) (ρ : ReqNames) (id : w64) : etcdstart.memberRestartRes n a γn γ ρ id ⊢
    ⌜ρ.rd.raft.raft = γ⌝ ∗ etcdstart.memberRestartRes n a γn γ ρ id

def etcdstart.memberWalDir (name : GoString) : GoString :=
  config.walDirOf (name ++ go!".etcd") []

theorem etcdstart.memberStartRes_fresh (n : GoString) (a : etcdstart.MemberAddrs) (γn : NetNames GF)
    (h : a.peer = none) : etcdstart.memberStartRes n a ⊢ etcdstart.memberFreshRes n a γn

def (sealed) etcdstart.memberFreshRes (name : GoString) (a : etcdstart.MemberAddrs) (γn : NetNames
    GF) : IProp GF

theorem etcdstart.memberStartRes_client.{u_1} (n : GoString) (a : etcdstart.MemberAddrs) (c :
    GoString) (h : a.client = some c) : etcdstart.memberStartRes n a ⊢ netAddrFree c ∗
    etcdstart.memberStartRes n { peer := a.peer }
